name: patch_magic_marker_in_file
description: Locks and opens a named file with the DOS library, reads a block into a buffer and scans it for the ASCII text 'magic'. When found, it overwrites the following 300 bytes with a global data block, writes the block back and then calls the other routine twice.

name: free_memory_or_return_value
description: Returns a stored value when a stored pointer is zero. Otherwise it calls the Exec FreeMem library routine and returns its result.

name: allocate_and_copy_block
description: Saves two table values into globals, allocates a memory block with Exec AllocMem and copies 96 bytes from a fixed data area into it. It then stores the block pointer and the pointer advanced by 18 bytes into globals.

name: call_two_subroutines
description: Only the call facts are known for this routine: it has four instructions and makes two calls to other routines, and no decompiled body is available. Its exact action cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: return_without_action
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

name: write_dos_prefix_bytes
description: Writes four bytes at the address held in the A1 register: the byte 100 followed by the ASCII letters 'os.', which together spell 'dos.'.

name: copy_longs_then_indirect_call
description: If the destination pointer is non-null, copies 16 longwords from a table at a fixed offset into it. It then makes an indirect call through a stored code pointer.

name: initialize_task_and_dispatch
description: Saves a register value and a pointer into globals, runs four subroutines and passes a computed structure pointer to an Exec library call. The library facts show task lookup, message port waiting and message passing are used by this code.

name: return_without_action
description: The routine contains only a return and performs no operations.

name: save_value_then_dispatch_calls
description: Stores its input value in a structure reached through a global pointer and calls two subroutines. When a global flag is set it makes two more library calls, then returns the stored value.

name: scan_hunk_file_until_end
description: Locks a named file and opens it through the DOS library, then reads entries in a loop until the value for the end-of-hunks marker appears. It releases the lock and closes the file if they were obtained.

name: release_lock_and_close_file
description: Calls one subroutine and clears a global flag. It then releases a file lock through the DOS library if its stored value is set, and closes a file handle if that is set, clearing each value afterwards.

name: open_two_libraries_with_fallback
description: Opens a first library through Exec OpenLibrary and stores its base, returning a fallback value if that fails. Otherwise it opens a second library, referenced in the text as intuition.library and nge.library, and returns its base when it opened, or the fallback value.

name: close_library_bases
description: Calls the Exec CloseLibrary function on a library base held in a global and clears that global. It then does the same for a second stored library base.

name: dispatch_hunk_type_codes
description: Dispatches on an AmigaDOS hunk type code. Code and data hunk types store a value into a table entry, relocation hunks add a base value to listed longwords, and the remaining codes loop over a count or return.

name: terminate_entries_and_open_library
description: Repeatedly calls subroutines and writes a zero byte at a computed address, then calls the Exec OpenLibrary function, until the returned value indicates the end of the list.

name: build_entry_table_and_allocate
description: Allocates a structure whose byte and short values come from globals, then fills a table of eight-byte entries whose type code depends on the sign and high bits of each value. It calls the Exec AllocEntry function and returns the result, or a fixed fallback value when that result is negative.

name: compute_entry_range_count
description: Calls a subroutine three times and stores each result in a global. It then stores the count of values from the second result to the third, inclusive, in another global.

name: mix_nonzero_table_entries
description: Applies a 32-step bit-serial mixing loop, seeded from a subroutine result, to each non-zero longword of a table and stores the result back. It returns -1 when a final subroutine result differs from the low word of the seed, otherwise that result.

name: repeat_subroutine_for_count
description: Calls a subroutine once for each count in the input register, decrementing the count until it reaches zero.

name: return_global_value_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine and then returns the value of a global variable, which this routine does not modify.

name: call_library_if_input_set
description: If the input register is non-zero, calls a library routine through a library base stored in a global variable, then returns.

name: toggle_bits_over_four_passes
description: Runs four passes that store the pass counter in a global and call subroutines each time. On even passes it issues a trap and toggles one bit of a byte buffer, advancing the buffer pointer.

name: call_pairs_with_early_exit
description: Calls two subroutines in each pass of a three-pass loop, and returns after the first pass because the flag it checks is always zero in this code.

name: wait_for_bounded_nonzero_value
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine until the low seven bits of its result are non-zero and not greater than 79.

name: call_pointer_or_default_value
description: Calls a function through a pointer stored in a global variable and returns its result, substituting the default value 65536 when that result is zero.

name: allocate_memory_with_fallback
description: Calls the Exec AllocMem library routine through a stored pointer and returns its result, substituting the default value 65536 when that result is zero.

name: call_pointer_if_both_set
description: If the masked input register and the address register are both non-zero, calls a function through a stored pointer.

name: free_memory_if_both_set
description: If the input register and the address register are both non-zero, calls the Exec FreeMem routine through a stored pointer.

name: compute_crc16_checksum
description: Computes a 16-bit checksum over a byte buffer of the given length, folding each byte into the accumulator and shifting it through eight bit steps with a fixed XOR constant. It returns the checksum in the high word of the result with the input register in the low part.

name: increment_counter_and_return
description: Calls a library function through a stored base when the counter is zero, then calls a subroutine with the counter and a fixed 32-bit constant. It stores the result plus one as the new counter and returns it together with the input register.

name: multiply_signed_fixed_point
description: Multiplies two signed 32-bit values by taking their absolute values, forming a 32-bit product from the 16-bit parts, and negating the result when exactly one input was negative.

name: check_paired_values_until_mismatch
description: Sets a global to a fixed value, then runs a fixed number of iterations that call subroutines and compare two returned values once a flag is set. It returns zero on the first mismatch and an all-ones value if the loop completes.

name: call_subroutine_once
description: Makes a single call to a subroutine and returns. The recovered code shows no further calls, so its only effect is that one call.

name: rotate_word_when_flag_set
description: Calls a subroutine to obtain a word and, when a condition flag is set, runs an eight-step loop that shifts and recombines its bits. It returns the resulting word.

name: wait_for_marker_word
description: Calls a subroutine in a loop, looking for the fixed marker word 17545. Each time it sees the marker it advances a counter by 15 and reads again, returning when the marker recurs or the flag is cleared.

name: loop_until_byte_matches
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine and compares its returned byte with a register value, advancing a counter by a fixed step each pass. It stops when the bytes match or the counter reaches zero.

name: combine_interleaved_bits_until_marker
description: Calls subroutines in a loop and combines their values by masking alternate bit positions and shifting them together. It returns the combined value once a byte-wide marker condition is met.

name: call_two_subroutines_conditionally
description: Calls one subroutine and, when a condition flag is set, also calls a second one. The result of the first call only sets the zero test, and the routine then returns.

name: read_sixteen_bits_from_table
description: If the bit index is beyond a global limit it returns a constant 1. Otherwise it assembles sixteen bits from a bit table, addressed from a global base by the bit index, into a word and returns it in the high part of the result.

name: open_disk_resource_and_wait
description: Opens the disk resource through the Exec library and stores it with related values. It fills a message block obtained from a subroutine with type 5 and the word 66, then loops calling library functions until a non-zero value is returned. The text disk.resource identifies the resource.

name: release_signal_after_library_calls
description: Calls subroutines around a sequence of library steps. It conditionally calls one library function when a stored value is set, makes two more library calls, and the facts list the Exec FreeSignal call among them.

name: create_request_port_message
description: Allocates a signal and, when that succeeds, allocates a message structure and fills in the signal number, a pointer to a global variable, the current task and an empty self-linked list. The text dskreq.port names the port used by this code.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Writes the disk pointer and control registers to start a disk DMA transfer. It sets the disk bits in the ADKCON register, optionally sets the DSKSYNC word, enables the disk DMA bit in DMACON, clears the disk interrupt request, and writes the disk length with its enable bit set.

name: start_disk_write_transfer
description: Waits while a flag bit in a global variable is set, then programs the disk pointer, ADKCON, DMACON, INTREQ and DSKLEN registers with the write-direction bit set to start a disk write transfer.

name: poll_flag_then_set_fields
description: Polls a flag word in a structure for up to 400000 iterations. When the flag is set it writes 2 to one word field and 16384 to another, then returns zero; otherwise it returns -1.

name: call_three_subroutines
description: Calls three subroutines in sequence and returns.

name: clear_indexed_bit_in_global
description: Stores the input byte into a global variable with one bit cleared, the bit chosen by a global index offset by three. The facts list the CIAB_PRB register as the hardware involved.

name: wait_for_ciaa_bit_clear
description: Polls a global variable for up to 50000 iterations and returns zero as soon as bit 5 is clear. If the bit stays set for the whole count it returns -1. The global reflects the CIAA_PRA register, which holds the fire buttons and disk status.

name: step_value_to_match_table_entry
description: Calls subroutines, then steps a word value up or down one unit at a time until it equals the low seven bits of a second value. It stores the matched value in a table entry selected by a global index and returns the input registers.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: poll_status_bit_and_clear_entry
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine while a status bit in a global variable is set. When the bit clears it zeroes a word in a table selected by a global index and returns the second input register value.

name: update_control_bits_with_delay
description: Updates a global control byte by clearing one bit selected by a global index, clearing bit 2 when a second flag is set, and forcing bit 0 on. It then busy-waits for 3000 iterations and uses the CIAB_PRB register according to the facts.

name: update_control_bits_clearing_pair
description: Updates a global control byte as the neighbouring bit-update routine does, but its final write also clears bit 1. It then busy-waits for 3000 iterations, and the facts list the CIAB_PRB register.

name: clear_control_bit_with_delay
description: Clears one bit of a global control byte selected by a global index and, when a second flag is set, clears bit 2 as well. It then busy-waits for 1500 iterations.

name: busy_wait_for_count
description: Counts the input register down to zero as a busy-wait delay.

name: check_bounds_then_store_word
description: Checks that the index register lies within a bound taken from a table entry and issues a trap if it does not, then writes a word to the destination. The decoded tail is marked as bad data, so the end of the routine is not reliable.

name: record_unresolved_entry_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show an entry routine of 163838 instructions that was executed in the reference run and entered from outside the static flow; its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: return_constant_minus_one
description: Returns the constant -1 without any other work. The routine has two instructions and was executed in the reference run.

name: copy_longs_then_indirect_call
description: If the stack argument pointer is non-null, copies 16 longwords from a table at a fixed offset from the address register into it. It then makes an indirect call through the code pointer held in another address register.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clears
description: Busy-waits while bit 6 of a global status variable is set, then returns zero. The global reflects the CIAA_PRA register, which holds the fire buttons and disk status.

name: use_dos_library_then_close
description: Opens a library through Exec OpenLibrary, calls two routines through that library's function table, then closes the Exec library with CloseLibrary and returns zero. The text dos.library is referenced.

name: decode_bitpacked_run_stream
description: Copies a block of global data to a fixed buffer, then decodes a bit-packed stream in which each step copies earlier output or emits literal bytes. An escape byte with the value 177 expands into a run of repeated bytes, and the decoding stops at a fixed output address; the facts also list the COLOR00 register as touched.

name: read_bitstream_longword_and_store_byte
description: Reads a longword that sits four bytes before the address register, stores its low byte through a second pointer, and returns the longword shifted right by one with its top bit set.

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Shifts the input bit buffer right once for each step of a count taken from the second input register. It refills the buffer from a subroutine whenever the buffer empties.

name: call_single_routine_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a two-instruction program entry that calls one routine; its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: load_hunks_and_apply_relocations
description: Allocates a table of hunk entries with Exec AllocMem, walks the hunk records by type code, and applies relocation records that add base addresses to listed longwords. The facts also show FreeMem and CopyMem calls.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return in the recovered code and performs no work.

name: decode_bitstream_backward_into_buffer
description: Decodes a compressed bitstream into a buffer filled from the end backwards. Each control bit selects either a copy of earlier output at a computed distance or a count of literal bytes read from the stream, and decoding stops when the output pointer reaches the start.

name: decompress_bitstream_data
description: Decompresses a bitstream into a buffer filled backwards, copying earlier output or literal bytes according to control bits. The stream start is read from a longword four bytes before the source pointer.

name: shift_bitbuffer_store_pointer
description: Shifts a bit buffer right once for each count in the second input register and stores the low word of the current pointer into a global on each pass. When the buffer empties it steps the pointer back and reloads the buffer with its top bit set.

name: call_two_routines_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a four-instruction program entry that calls two routines; its purpose cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: copy_block_to_fixed_address
description: Copies 365 longwords from a global variable area to a fixed memory address and returns zero. The routine is entered from outside the static flow and was executed in the reference run.

name: record_unresolved_hardware_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show an entry routine that touches the COLOR00 colour register, the DMACON DMA control register and the INTENA interrupt enable register, and calls one routine; its exact action cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: record_unresolved_dma_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a routine that touches the DMACON register, references the text PLOT.BOOT and calls two routines; its exact action cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: copy_table_and_update_state
description: Sets bit 1 of a global status variable and calls a subroutine. It then copies 1001 longwords from a table to a fixed low address, sets the global to 32767 and updates a longword by XOR with a fixed value.

name: set_global_and_xor_longword
description: Sets a global variable to 32767 and XOR-updates a longword with a fixed constant, then returns. The facts list the DMACON and INTENA registers as touched.

name: lookup_hashed_name_entry
description: Converts a null-terminated name to upper case and computes a hash of its characters, reducing it modulo 72 to choose a table entry. It walks that entry's chain comparing stored names and copies the matched data into the output buffer, or sets a status code when no entry exists.

name: lookup_hashed_name_with_selector
description: Stores its input byte in a structure, then performs the same hash-table lookup as its neighbouring routine: it reduces a name hash modulo 72, walks the entry chain and copies the matched data on a match. It sets a status code on each failure path.

name: lookup_entry_by_index_and_copy
description: Takes an index from the data register, fetches the table entry at that index, and walks the entry chain comparing stored names. On a match it copies the associated data into the output buffer, and it sets status code 1 when no entry exists.

name: set_status_six_and_exit
description: Stores the status value 6 in a structure field, writes a fixed return address into the saved stack slot, calls a subroutine and returns.

name: set_status_seven_and_exit
description: Stores the status value 7 in a structure field, writes a fixed return address into the saved stack slot, calls a subroutine and returns.

name: compare_name_and_copy_entry
description: Compares the characters of a stored name with an input string. When every character matches it copies the associated values into the output buffer, and when they differ it advances to the next stored entry and repeats the comparison.

name: scan_entries_for_name_match
description: Walks stored entries, comparing each entry name with the input text, and copies the associated data to the output buffer on a match. It sets status code 6 or 7 when the structure is not valid and returns through the common exit.

name: copy_entry_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a list of words from the structure into the output buffer, repeating until a count stored in the structure is exhausted. It sets status code 5 when the first check fails, then returns through the common exit.

name: copy_bytes_until_flag_clear
description: Writes an all-ones sentinel word to the output pointer, then repeatedly copies a block of bytes from a structure into the output buffer until a counter in the structure goes negative.

name: set_status_one_and_exit
description: Stores the status value 1 in a structure field, writes a fixed return address into the saved stack slot, calls a subroutine and returns.

name: verify_structure_checksum
description: Temporarily zeroes one field of a structure, sums 128 longwords from its start, restores the field and compares the stored value with the negated sum. It returns zero when they match and -1 otherwise.

name: set_status_five_and_exit
description: Stores the status value 5 in a structure field, writes a fixed return address into the saved stack slot, calls a subroutine and returns.

name: locate_track_with_retry_limit
description: Reads a table entry and divides its value by 22 to get a track number and remainder, then adjusts the remainder and sets a side flag. It calls a routine repeatedly, counts failed attempts and returns error status 2 after more than four retries.

name: retry_operation_with_limit
description: Clears two counters, sets a control word and calls routines in a loop, counting failed attempts. After more than four failures it sets status 2 and returns; otherwise it stores a combined position value and returns zero. The facts list the CIAB_PRB and DMACON registers.

name: retry_with_recovery_limit
description: Calls a pair of subroutines repeatedly while counting attempts. Each block of five failures triggers a recovery call, and after five such blocks it sets status code 2; on success it stores a combined position value and returns.

name: reset_retry_counters_store_position
description: Clears two retry counters, stores a combined position value in a structure field, and returns its input value.

name: set_flag_bit_and_step_position
description: Sets bit 2 of a control byte according to a global flag and calls a subroutine. It then steps a stored position toward a target by calling subroutines until the two values are equal.

name: clear_flag_bit_and_step_position
description: Clears bit 2 of a control byte and calls a subroutine. If a stored field is negative it resets that field, then steps a stored position toward a target until the two values are equal.

name: step_until_positions_equal
description: Calls a subroutine once and then repeatedly calls subroutines while two global position values differ, returning once they are equal.

name: wait_while_busy_bit_set
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine while bit 4 of a byte at a fixed offset from an address register is set, then clears a status field.

name: wait_while_busy_bit_set
description: Calls a subroutine while bit 4 of a byte at a fixed offset from an address register is set, then clears a status field.

name: increment_counter_until_limit
description: Calls a subroutine and increments a counter field after each call, repeating until the counter reaches 79.

name: call_and_increment_until_limit
description: While a counter field is below 79, calls a subroutine and then increments that counter field.

name: clear_bit_one_and_count
description: Clears bit 1 of a byte through an address register, calls a subroutine and increments a counter field.

name: set_bit_one_and_count_down
description: Sets bit 1 of a byte through an address register, calls a subroutine and decrements a counter field.

name: set_bit_zero_and_call
description: Clears and then sets bit 0 of a byte through an address register, which leaves bit 0 set, and then calls a subroutine.

name: busy_wait_on_vhposr
description: Spins reading the VHPOSR vertical position register in a loop, then returns its input register unchanged. The decompiled loop condition does not resolve to a clear exit, so the exact wait is uncertain.

name: wait_bit_five_with_timeout
description: Polls bit 5 of a byte at a fixed offset from an address register for up to 327680 iterations. If the bit stays set for the whole count it sets status code 4 and exits; otherwise it returns its input.

name: set_status_four_and_exit
description: Stores the status value 4 in a structure field, writes a fixed return address into the saved stack slot, calls a subroutine and returns.

name: start_disk_read_with_timeout
description: Programs the ADKCON, DSKSYNC and disk pointer registers for a read, writes a DSKLEN value with the read direction to start it, and waits for a ready bit in a CIA byte. It then polls for up to 327680 iterations and sets status code 3 when the wait times out.

name: stop_disk_dma_transfer
description: Writes 16384 to the DSKLEN register, which clears the disk length with its enable bit off and so stops the disk DMA transfer.

name: find_sync_and_decode_sector
description: Scans a buffer for the disk sync word 17545 and checks the track and sector fields of the header against expected values, with two comparisons. When they match it decodes 128 longwords from interleaved odd and even bit groups into the destination and returns zero, otherwise -1.

name: verify_and_decode_sector_block
description: Scans for the sync word, checks header fields and verifies two pairs of values, then decodes 128 longwords from interleaved bit groups into the destination. It returns -1 on any mismatch and zero on success.

name: decode_sector_if_checksums_match
description: Calls two subroutines and compares their results. When they are equal it decodes 128 longwords from interleaved bit groups into the destination and returns zero; otherwise it returns -1.

name: decode_sector_longwords
description: Decodes 128 longwords from interleaved odd and even bit groups into the destination, clears a counter field and returns zero.

name: return_negative_one
description: Returns -1 without other work.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: xor_checksum_longwords
description: XORs a run of longwords from a buffer into an accumulator, with the run length taken from the input register, and returns the accumulator masked with a second register.

name: clear_ciab_bit_three_pulse
description: Writes 127 to the CIAB port B register, clears bit 3 of it, and calls two subroutines around the write. The facts list the CIAB_PRB register.

name: toggle_ciab_bit_three_pulse
description: Sets bits 3 and 7 of the CIAB port B register, calls a subroutine, clears bit 3 and calls again, then sets bit 3 once more. The facts list the CIAB_PRB register.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded body is bad data: the pseudo-code shows only the bad-data marker and no usable instructions. Its two callers are unnamed routines, so no behaviour can be recovered.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded body is bad data: the pseudo-code shows only the bad-data marker and no usable instructions. The facts show a 14336-instruction entry executed in the reference run, so no behaviour can be recovered from this evidence.

description: Sets bits 7 and 3 of a byte through an address register, calls a subroutine, clears bit 3 and calls again, then sets bit 3 and makes an indirect jump through a pointer the decompiler could not recover.

key: dyna blaster (1991)(hudson soft)[cr vf][a2]/Dyna Blaster (1991)(Hudson Soft)[cr VF][a2].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_read_and_decode_data
description: Boot block entry, called by the Kickstart strap. It fills an I/O request block with a read command, length, offset and buffer, issues it through the Exec library call at offset -456, clears a block of globals and runs a loop that decodes bitstream data into the buffer.

key: Dyna Blaster (1991)(Hudson Soft)[cr VF][a2].adf boot-block load +$39C00 to $020000 (17408 bytes):0:00F2
name: select_half_or_input
description: Returns the input word unchanged, unless the flag register equals 1, in which case it returns half of a second word.

key: Dyna Blaster (1991)(Hudson Soft)[cr VF][a2].adf boot-block load +$39C00 to $020000 (17408 bytes):0:010A
name: mask_table_word_lookup
description: Looks up a word in a table at a fixed address, indexed by twice the input register, and returns it ANDed with a second input word.

name: run_copper_setup_then_idle
description: Writes a copper pointer value and several control words, calls four subroutines, then busy-waits on a status value and loops forever. The facts list the COP1LCH, DMACON, DMACONR, INTENA, INTREQ and VHPOSR registers as touched.

name: copy_two_blocks_and_init_registers
description: Copies 2560 longwords between two fixed memory areas, then copies a second pair of blocks of 9280 longwords each in one loop. It waits while bit 6 of a byte at a small offset is set, and stores a set of initial values into a structure.

name: or_strided_word_rows
description: ORs five words spaced 18 words apart and writes the result to five matching destination words, across two blocks of 17 columns over 26 and 22 rows.

name: fill_split_address_table
description: Fills two tables of four entries each, storing the high and low halves of two incrementing addresses. Each step advances both addresses by 32.

name: fade_colour_words_by_step
description: Toggles a flip flag and, on every second call while a step counter is below sixteen, scales eight three-nibble colour words by the step count and stores them in a table. The output table is the only result written.

name: fade_colour_table_block
description: Toggles a flip flag and, on every second call, calls a routine and then scales a block of 32 three-nibble colour words by the current step count, writing them to a second table.

name: scale_colour_words_down_step
description: Decrements the step counter and, if it was non-zero, scales a run of three-nibble words read from the input pointer by the new step count into the output pointer.

name: setup_blitter_registers_once
description: Waits until the blitter-busy bit is clear, then writes control words, masks and pointer values to the blitter register block to set up one blitter operation.

name: setup_blitter_with_fixed_values
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear, then writes a fixed set of control words, masks and addresses to the blitter register block.

name: setup_blitter_with_modulo_values
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear, then writes control, mask, modulo and source and destination pointer values to the blitter register block.

name: advance_blitter_table_entry
description: Counts down a step, and when it reaches zero loads the next entry from a table of blitter parameters, stopping at a sentinel of -1. After waiting for the blitter-busy bit to clear it writes the entry values to the blitter registers.

name: advance_second_blitter_table_entry
description: Uses a second counter and index to walk a blitter parameter table with the same logic as the neighbouring table walker, stopping at a sentinel of -1 and writing the entry values to the blitter registers after the busy bit clears.

name: update_blitter_frame_parameters
description: Advances a frame counter and, on schedule, toggles one value and adds 320 to another. It then writes two blitter operations whose addresses are offset from a computed base, waiting for the busy bit before each.

name: reissue_blitter_copy_with_offset
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear, then writes control words, masks and two pointers derived from a saved offset to the blitter register block.

name: step_table_and_setup_blitter
description: Steps a counter that reloads parameter values from a table when it expires. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations whose addresses come from the stepped offset.

name: cycle_four_entry_index
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index modulo four and loads two values from tables for that index.

name: advance_blitter_accumulators
description: Decrements two step counters and, when they expire, reloads parameters from a table and adds them into accumulators. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations using the accumulated values.

name: advance_blitter_accumulators
description: Decrements two step counters and, when they expire, reloads parameters from a table and adds them into accumulators. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations using the accumulated values.

name: update_blitter_word_and_run
description: ORs a constant into a longword and adds a value to a second word. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations using the accumulated values, advancing the accumulator afterwards.

name: run_blitter_operation_pair
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear and writes two blitter operations whose addresses are built from accumulated values. The routine also updates a longword and a word in place.

name: advance_four_slot_index
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, advances a four-slot index and loads a value from a table. It returns the slot offset.

name: advance_four_slot_table_value
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, advances a four-slot index and loads the next table value into a stored word.

name: advance_blitter_table_accumulators
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, loads the next table entry and adds its step values to two accumulators. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations using the accumulated values.

name: advance_blitter_table_accumulators
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, loads the next table entry and adds its step values to two accumulators. It then waits for the blitter-busy bit and writes two blitter operations using the accumulated values.

name: set_flag_and_run_blitter
description: ORs a constant into a word, waits for the blitter-busy bit, then writes two blitter operations built from accumulated values. It advances the accumulator afterwards.

name: advance_four_slot_index
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, advances a two-bit slot index modulo four and loads a table value for that slot. It returns the slot offset.

name: advance_four_slot_table_value
description: Decrements a counter and, when it expires, advances a four-slot index and loads the next table value into a stored word.

name: read_cia_nibble_with_retries
description: Reads a value through a CIA-related global register up to four times, masking each read to its low nibble, and returns the value once the nibble equals 15. If no read succeeds it reads once more and returns a value looked up in a table. The facts list the CIA and CIAB_PRA registers.

name: write_cia_control_bits
description: Sets or clears bit 2 of a global CIA control value according to bit 0 of the input, stores the input's upper bits shifted into the control value, and returns the inverted masked value. The facts list the CIA and CIAB_PRA registers.

name: acknowledge_interrupt_requests
description: Reads the interrupt request register and, when bit 4 is set, writes a beam-position word and sets a global. When bit 5 is set it calls a routine, then clears the requested interrupts by writing the value back to INTREQ.

name: run_forever_setup_loop
description: Runs forever: each pass calls several routines, writes the values 32767 and 15 into two hardware-register fields, sets a pointer and may update a global. The facts show seven calls and no library calls.

name: wait_for_flag_then_halt
description: Busy-waits until a global byte equals 66, the ASCII code for B, then loops forever without returning.

name: wait_for_flag_then_halt
description: Busy-waits until a global byte equals 66, the ASCII code for B, then loops forever. The facts list the COP1LCH, DMACON, INTENA and VHPOSR registers as touched in this routine's region, but the recovered body shows only the wait.

name: wait_raster_lines_in_loop
description: Sets a global byte and a word, then calls the raster wait routine twice per iteration while a counter runs up to 17. The facts list the DMACON register as touched.

name: count_down_raster_waits
description: Calls the raster wait routine twice per step while a counter counts down to zero, then clears the counter.

name: fade_colour_words_by_counter
description: Scales 32 three-nibble colour words by a counter value and stores them back in place.

name: pulse_ciab_port_and_set_global
description: Calls subroutines and loops until a returned value reaches zero, then drives the CIAB port B register high, low and high again around a subroutine call, and sets a global to 523264.

name: read_disk_sectors_with_sync_search
description: Starts a disk read with the sync word 17545 and waits for the disk interrupt flag, then searches the buffer for header sync words. For each sector it compares a header value with the XOR of 256 words and, on a match, decodes 128 longwords into the output until a counter runs out.

name: step_word_to_target_value
description: Sets or clears bit 2 of a control byte according to bit 0 of the input, then steps a stored word toward the target value, the input shifted right by one, calling a subroutine each step until they are equal.

name: clear_word_and_wait_for_marker
description: Waits while bit 4 of a global control value is set, clears a word and sets bit 2 of a control byte. It then waits for a byte at offset 6 to read B and then A, the ASCII codes of those letters.

name: decrement_word_and_wait_for_marker
description: Sets bit 1 and clears bit 0 of a control byte around subroutine calls, decrements a stored word, then waits for a byte at offset 6 to read B and then A.

name: increment_word_and_wait_for_marker
description: Clears bit 1 and bit 0 of a control byte around subroutine calls, increments a stored word, then waits for a byte at offset 6 to read B and then A.

name: set_port_byte_pulse
description: Writes 127 to a byte through an address register, calls a subroutine, then writes 119 to the same byte.

name: spin_on_global_byte
description: Spins on a global byte. The decompiled condition is always true, so as recovered the routine does not return. The facts list the VHPOSR register as touched.

name: check_form_header_and_process
description: Compares the first longword at the input pointer with the tag FORM and, when it matches, calls two subroutines. Otherwise it returns without action.

name: convert_cmap_chunk_to_words
description: Searches a chunk list for the tag CMAP and converts its three-byte colour entries into 12-bit word values stored in a global table. The entry count is the chunk size divided by three.

name: unpack_body_chunk_runs
description: Searches a chunk list for the tag BODY and unpacks its data into the output buffer. A negative count repeats the following byte, while a non-negative count copies that many bytes, and a flag byte selects a verbatim copy instead.

name: decrunch_imp_packed_block
description: When the IMP! signature matches, decodes a packed stream backwards into the buffer: bit-controlled counts select either a copy of earlier output or a run of literal bytes, stopping when the output pointer reaches the start.

name: decrunch_imp_in_place
description: Checks the IMP! signature at the input pointer, updates three header longwords, then decodes the packed stream backwards with the same bit-controlled copy and literal scheme as its neighbour, writing the output in place.

name: clear_interrupt_request_bits
description: If bit 4 of the interrupt request register is set, writes a beam-position word and sets a global. It then writes the interrupt request value back to the INTREQ register to clear the requested bits.

name: initialise_player_channel_state
description: Zeroes a 97-longword state block, sets four channel table entries and builds per-channel offsets from a pattern table. It clears a status byte at the end and does not write hardware registers itself.

name: update_audio_channels_per_frame
description: Runs once per frame and advances pattern counters for four channels. When a channel's counter expires it writes that channel's start pointer and length into its audio register block, then copies a status value to a global.

name: initialise_audio_player_tables
description: Initialises the audio player state from a second set of base addresses: zeroes the state block, sets four channel table entries and builds per-channel offsets from a pattern table. It clears a status byte at the end.

name: update_audio_channel_registers
description: Runs the per-frame update of the second player block: it advances the pattern counters of four channels and writes start pointers and lengths into their audio register blocks when a counter expires.

name: step_four_channel_sample_loops
description: Advances four audio channel records once per call. For each channel it toggles one sample byte, moves a playback offset by a stored step and wraps it according to a loop mode, then clears the per-channel flags.

name: load_channel_sample_parameters
description: Reads a table entry selected by a channel's index and stores the sample pointer, a volume-style byte and a second byte into the channel record, clearing a flag afterwards.

name: advance_channel_playback_step
description: Stores a pointer into a channel record and, when a trigger field is set, resets the channel counters. When a counter is non-zero it adds a stored step to a target word and advances the channel's position.

name: decode_channel_command_bytes
description: Reads command bytes from a pattern stream for one channel. While its wait count is non-zero it counts that down; otherwise it reads the next bytes and stores up to four values in the channel record, with a negative byte setting the wait count instead.

name: trigger_channel_note_setup
description: When a channel's trigger field is non-zero, resets its effect fields and sets its sample pointer, length and period from tables indexed by the note and instrument bytes.

name: apply_channel_period_slide
description: Adds a slide step to a channel's period value, clamps the result to a minimum of 95 and a maximum of 5760, and writes it to that channel's audio period register.

name: advance_channel_effect_counter
description: Checks a channel's effect parameter and, when it is non-zero, increments a counter until it matches the parameter. Once they match it adds the parameter to a slide accumulator.

name: dispatch_channel_effect_command
description: Dispatches on the low nibble of a channel's effect word, handling arpeggio, slide, vibrato, volume and offset commands from the stored parameter values. Each case returns through the common exit.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: Looks up a target period in a table and moves the channel's current period toward it by the stored slide step on each call, clamping at the target. It stores the new target and returns the period when it changes.

name: set_period_from_note_table
description: Looks up a period in a table using the channel's base index plus a value derived from the stored parameter byte, and writes it to the channel period field.
